knownLimitations: The reference workspace uses explicitly labelled sample data, not client telemetry.
NEXT_PUBLIC_POLAR_INFRASTRUCTURE_BLUEPRINT_URL is not configured; checkout uses an invoice-led engagement intake.
No client operational database, ERP connector credentials, energy telemetry, bank facility or production agent tenant is provisioned in this public reference release.
The public contract structures are issue maps and decision frameworks, not executable legal, tax, credit, insurance or energy-market advice.
Vercel preview deployments are noindex; production-domain indexing is verified separately after merge.
No remote screenshot-capable browser was available; rendered HTML, metadata, responsive source and build output were inspected.
